title: Rethinking Underwater Image Enhancement: Learning through Text-Guided Degradation Curriculum
title_zh: 重新思考水下图像增强：通过文本引导的退化课程进行学习

paragraphs.en: Existing paired clean–degraded datasets have advanced learning-based underwater image enhancement, but they remain either limited in scale or difficult to acquire, and still fail to adequately cover the diverse degradations encountered in real-world underwater environments. Such scarce and insufficient data ultimately restrict the generalization of underwater image enhancement models, highlighting the need for realistic and controllable degradation modeling to better capture real underwater conditions and improve enhancement robustness. To this end, we propose a unified degradation-aware training framework for the underwater image enhancement task. A Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline uses a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent degraded samples, providing paired data to support the subsequent curriculum learning strategy. The proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum organizes training across multiple attributes and difficulty levels to promote balanced learning, and a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model leverages this progressive process to better address the wide range of degradation severity and restoration ambiguity in underwater images. Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance. Our code and models will be released upon the publication of this work.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的成对“清晰–退化”数据集推动了基于学习的水下图像增强的发展，但它们要么规模有限，要么难以获取，仍然无法充分覆盖真实水下环境中遇到的多样化退化。 这种稀缺且不足的数据最终限制了水下图像增强模型的泛化能力，凸显了对真实且可控的退化建模的需求，以更好地刻画真实水下条件并提升增强的鲁棒性。 为此，我们提出一个面向水下图像增强任务的统一的退化感知训练框架。 文本条件化的退化增强流水线利用文本引导的扩散模型合成多样且语义一致的退化样本，提供成对数据以支持后续的课程学习策略。 所提出的渐进式退化课程在多个属性和难度级别上组织训练以促进均衡学习，而传输引导的单步扩散模型则利用这一渐进过程，更好地应对水下图像中广泛的退化程度和恢复模糊性。 在多个水下基准上的大量实验表明，我们提出的方法取得了优越的性能。 我们的代码和模型将在本工作发表后发布。

paragraphs.en: Underwater Image Enhancement (UIE) aims to recover clear, color-consistent, and detail-preserving images from degraded underwater observations. Unlike uniform degradations in common image restoration tasks, underwater degradations are highly heterogeneous and scene-dependent, where they vary with water type, depth, illumination, and particle density, and often exhibit complex spatial coupling among these factors. Consequently, the underlying degradation distribution is extremely difficult to model or approximate with a fixed prior, making UIE an intrinsically ill-posed and data-sensitive problem.
paragraphs.zh: 水下图像增强（UIE）旨在从退化的水下观测中恢复清晰、色彩一致且保留细节的图像。 与常见图像修复任务中的均匀退化不同，水下退化具有高度异质性和场景依赖性，其随水体类型、深度、光照和颗粒密度而变化，并且这些因素之间往往表现出复杂的空间耦合。 因此，底层退化分布极难用固定先验进行建模或近似，这使得UIE成为一个本质上的不适定且对数据敏感的问题。

paragraphs.en: Acquiring paired underwater data is inherently challenging because capturing the same scene under both degraded and clean conditions is almost impossible in dynamic environments. As illustrated in Figure 1 -Top, such pairs are commonly obtained through (i) controlled water-tank capture Duarte et al. (2016) , (ii) pseudo-reference generation by manually selecting outputs from multiple UIE methods Li et al. (2019a) ; Peng et al. (2023) , or (iii) synthetic rendering with simplified underwater formation models Islam et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2017) ; Ye et al. (2022) ; Li et al. (2020) . The first two routes provide visually realistic supervision but are costly and difficult to scale, whereas the third enables scalable generation but often fails to reproduce the complex lighting and scattering effects of natural underwater scenes.

paragraphs.en: These limitations reveal that the main bottleneck of UIE lies not only in model architecture but also in the lack of realistic and controllable degradation modeling for generating diverse training variants. Moreover, underwater degradations vary drastically in strength and composition—ranging from light color cast to dense scattering and mixed turbidity. This motivates us to rethink UIE — not as direct restoration, but as learning from degradation , where controllable, text-guided degradation modeling provides structured, degradation-aware supervision for enhancement learning. In addition, we argue that if degradations can be explicitly modeled and controlled, they can serve as a meaningful curriculum for enhancement, where the model gradually adapts to increasingly challenging degradations across multiple attributes and severity levels, which encourages more generalized enhancement performance.
paragraphs.zh: 这些局限性表明，UIE 的主要瓶颈不仅在于模型架构，还在于缺乏真实且可控的退化建模来生成多样化的训练变体。 此外，水下退化在强度和构成上差异巨大——从轻微色偏到浓密散射和混合浑浊不等。 这促使我们重新思考 UIE——不是将其视为直接复原，而是视为从退化中学习，其中可控的、文本引导的退化建模为增强学习提供了结构化且退化感知的监督。 另外，我们认为，如果退化能够被显式建模和控制，它们就可以作为增强的有意义的课程，使模型在多个属性和严重程度上逐渐适应越来越具挑战性的退化，从而促进更泛化的增强性能。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we revisit underwater enhancement from a new perspective-leveraging the generative capability of the diffusion model to explicitly model and control underwater degradations (Figure 1 -Medium). Diffusion-based generative models Labs et al. (2025) provide an expressive latent space in which degradations can be synthesized and conditioned on semantic cues such as turbidity, illumination, or particle density. This text-conditioned formulation enables fine-grained control over degradation attributes and supports large-scale data augmentation aligned with real underwater characteristics. The generated degradations further provide difficulty-aware cues that guide enhancement models to learn progressively under well-structured degradation distributions, yielding more stable optimization and visually coherent restoration across diverse underwater conditions. Moreover, we develop a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion enhancer that injects a transmission prior into the latent space and performs a single deterministic reverse update, providing transmission-guided restoration with lower sampling cost than multi-step diffusion methods. Together, these designs establish a cohesive paradigm that unifies controllable degradation modeling and physically guided enhancement, offering a new perspective on the UIE task.

paragraphs.en: Overall, our contributions can be summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的贡献可以总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce a Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation (TCDA) pipeline that leverages a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize controllable degraded variants of clean images, enabling fine-grained attribute/severity control for task-aligned data augmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种文本条件退化增强（Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation, TCDA）流水线，它利用文本引导的扩散模型来合成清晰图像的可控退化变体，从而实现细粒度的属性/严重程度控制，用于任务对齐的数据增强。

paragraphs.en: We employ a progressive degradation curriculum learning that gradually increases training difficulty, stabilizing optimization and improving the model’s robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用渐进式退化课程学习，逐步增加训练难度，从而稳定优化过程并提升模型的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: We design a Transmission-Guided One-step Diffusion model (TG-Diff) that embeds a transmission prior into the latent space, achieving high-quality restoration with greater inference efficiency than multi-step diffusion methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种传输引导单步扩散模型（TG-Diff），它将传输先验嵌入到潜在空间中，以比多步扩散方法更高的推理效率实现高质量复原。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在多个水下基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法达到了最先进的性能。

paragraphs.en: Traditional UIE methods are typically built upon the underwater image formation model that characterizes light scattering and absorption. Early works such as underwater dark channel prior Drews et al. (2013) , red channel prior Galdran et al. (2015) , and blurriness-based estimation Chiang and Chen (2011) estimate the transmission map and background light to remove haze and recover true colors. More recent prior-based methods further exploit illumination characteristics to handle non-uniform lighting and color degradation Hou et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2025b) . However, their performance heavily depends on accurate estimation of water parameters and scene depth, limiting their robustness across varying underwater conditions Liu et al. (2020) . Deep learning has revolutionized UIE by providing strong nonlinear modeling and robust feature representation capabilities. Early convolutional methods Li et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2021) ; Wang et al. (2021) ; Zhang et al. (2022) ; Wei et al. (2022) employed encoder–decoder or multi-branch architectures to learn direct mappings from degraded to clean images, achieving improved contrast and color fidelity through illumination modeling and multi-level feature learning. Adversarial and generative frameworks Fabbri et al. (2018) ; Wang et al. (2019) further enhanced perceptual realism but often introduced instability and color over-saturation. Moreover, some works use contrastive learning Zhou et al. (2024) , domain priors, and external knowledge to improve UIE generalization and controllability. PhaseFormer Khan et al. (2025) introduces phase-based attention to preserve structural cues, while CLIP-UIE Liu et al. (2025) utilizes semantic guidance from vision-language models. Semantic-Guided Diffusion Zhou et al. (2025a) leverages multimodal cues from LLaVA and Zip-CLIP to generate semantic heatmaps for diffusion guidance.

paragraphs.en: The scarcity of paired and diverse underwater data has motivated the research on underwater image synthesis. Early physics-based methods simulate light attenuation using simplified water models but fail to reproduce complex scattering Ye et al. (2022) ; Li et al. (2020) . Alternatively, some datasets create pseudo-references by applying multiple UIE methods to a degraded image and having a user select the best outcome as the “clean” target Li et al. (2019a) . While visually plausible, this approach is fundamentally limited as it provides no insight into the forward degradation process itself. It merely offers a single, fixed enhancement target for each input, failing to model the diverse and controllable degradation attributes (e.g., water type, turbidity) that are crucial for robust generalization. GAN-based approaches Li et al. (2017) ; Islam et al. (2020) improve realism but suffer from domain bias and unstable training. Recent diffusion-driven frameworks, including Atlantis++ Zhang et al. (2026) and TIDE Lin et al. (2025) , enable text- or depth-conditioned underwater scene synthesis. However, these methods focus on generating underwater scenes rather than modeling controllable degradations. Our work uniquely fills this gap by introducing a controllable, text-driven degradation diffusion model that synthesizes diverse and realistic underwater degradations, providing richer supervision and significantly enhancing the generalization of UIE models.

paragraphs.en: Our methodology addresses the challenges of underwater image enhancement through a two-stage framework. First, to overcome the bottleneck of limited diversity and fixed degradation patterns in existing datasets, we introduce a Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation (TCDA) pipeline. This pipeline synthesizes a vast and diverse corpus of degraded images with controllable degradation attributes specified by fine-grained text prompts. Second, leveraging this augmented data, we employ a progressive degradation curriculum to train a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion (TG-Diff) model, designed for transmission-guided image restoration with greater inference efficiency than multi-step diffusion methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法通过一个两阶段框架来解决水下图像增强的挑战。 首先，为克服现有数据集多样性有限且退化模式固定这一瓶颈，我们引入了文本条件退化增强（TCDA）流水线。 该流水线合成了一个庞大且多样的退化图像语料库，其可控退化属性由细粒度文本提示指定。 其次，利用这些增强数据，我们采用渐进式退化课程来训练一个透射率引导的单步扩散（TG-Diff）模型，该模型面向透射率引导的图像恢复，并比多步扩散方法具有更高的推理效率。

paragraphs.en: To fully leverage our text-conditioned degradation model, we construct a structured prompt bank. Specifically, instead of relying on unconstrained free-form prompts, we organize the prompt space around six degradation attributes, including turbidity, color cast, particles, lighting, haze/backscatter, and contrast. For each attribute, we define phrases with different severity levels and group them into three difficulty tiers, i.e., easy, moderate, and hard, so that the resulting prompts are both semantically coherent and explicitly controllable. Each prompt is a tuple T deg = ( a 1 , … , a K , d ) T_{\text{deg}}=(a_{1},\ldots,a_{K},d) , detailing key attributes { a k } \{a_{k}\} and a difficulty level d ∈ { easy , moderate , hard } d\in\{\texttt{easy},\texttt{moderate},\texttt{hard}\} . During synthesis, given a clean image I clean I_{\text{clean}} and any such prompt T deg T_{\text{deg}} , our model generates a corresponding degraded image I deg I_{\text{deg}} . This text-driven paradigm not only enables fine-grained semantic control over degradation types and intensities but also provides the multi-difficulty data crucial for our progressive enhancement training, as detailed next. Representative prompt-conditioned degradation results are shown in Figure 4 . Detailed design is described in Supplementary Sec. 2.2.

paragraphs.en: Directly training a restoration model on the full, diverse spectrum of degradations generated by TCDA can lead to instability and slow convergence. To address this, we introduce a progressive degradation curriculum that leverages the difficulty levels defined in our prompt bank. This curriculum gradually increases the degradation complexity during training, allowing the model to first master fundamental color and tone restoration before tackling more complex scattering and contrast loss.

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. In the TCDA pipeline, we utilize two NVIDIA A800 GPUs (80 GB) for training the degradation diffusion model. We adopt a LoRA fine-tuning strategy with a rank of 8. All the images are resized to 1024×1024 in the training process. The model is optimized using AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a per-GPU batch size of 1. We train the model for two epochs. During inference, we employ 28 denoising steps for text-conditioned degradation synthesis. For training the TG-Diff, we adopt the Stable Diffusion-Turbo Sauer et al. (2024) as our base model and fine-tune it with LoRA of rank 32. During the training process, the samples are randomly cropped into 256 × \times 256 patches from the original images. We train the model for 50,000 iterations using the AdamW optimizer ( β 1 = 0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{1}=0.9,\beta_{2}=0.999 ) with a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a batch size of 12 per GPU. paragraphs.en: Datasets and Evaluation Metrics. All images in the UIEB dataset Li et al. (2019a) are first divided into 790 images for training and 100 images for testing. Based on 790 training images, we further utilize our text-conditioned degradation augmentation (TCDA) model to produce 10,270 augmented images. These augmented images are categorized into three difficulty levels (easy, moderate, and hard) with a ratio of 5:5:3. To assess the benefit of TCDA, we train all underwater image enhancement models with and without 10,270 augmented images, and then evaluate them on the same UIEB test set. For paired evaluations, we report PSNR Huynh-Thu and Ghanbari (2008) , SSIM Wang et al. (2004) , and LPIPS Zhang et al. (2018) to measure reconstruction fidelity. For unpaired evaluations, we employ two no-reference underwater quality metrics: UCIQE Yang and Sowmya (2015) and UIQM Panetta et al. (2015) . In addition, we assess performance on the reference-free UIEB C60 subset Li et al. (2019a) and U45 dataset Li et al. (2019b) , using UCIQE and UIQM to measure enhancement quality under unpaired conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集与评估指标。UIEB 数据集（Li et al., 2019a）中的所有图像首先被划分为 790 张训练图像和 100 张测试图像。基于这 790 张训练图像，我们进一步利用我们的文本条件退化增强（TCDA）模型生成 10,270 张增强图像。这些增强图像按 5:5:3 的比例被划分为三个难度级别（简单、中等和困难）。为了评估 TCDA 的收益，我们分别在有和没有这 10,270 张增强图像的情况下训练所有水下图像增强模型，然后在相同的 UIEB 测试集上进行评估。对于成对评估，我们报告 PSNR（Huynh-Thu and Ghanbari, 2008）、SSIM（Wang et al., 2004）和 LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018）来衡量重建保真度。对于非成对评估，我们采用两种无参考水下质量指标：UCIQE（Yang and Sowmya, 2015）和 UIQM（Panetta et al., 2015）。此外，我们在无参考的 UIEB C60 子集（Li et al., 2019a）和 U45 数据集（Li et al., 2019b）上评估性能，使用 UCIQE 和 UIQM 来衡量非成对条件下的增强质量。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Evaluation. Figure 5 presents visual comparisons on representative UIEB examples with different degradation levels. Existing methods often suffer from distinct artifacts: UIEC 2 -Net tends to leave residual haze and muted colors, SCNet and FiveA+ may introduce over-enhancement or unnatural color shifts, WF-Diff and CE-VAE sometimes fail to fully recover fine structures, and Phaseformer, although stronger, still shows less stable restoration under severe degradations. In contrast, our TG-Diff produces clearer visibility, more natural color balance, and better local detail recovery, as highlighted in the enlarged regions. After incorporating TCDA, “Ours+TCDA” further improves restoration fidelity, especially in heavily degraded scenes, where it removes haze more thoroughly and recovers clearer textures and structures. These results verify that the proposed data-centric curriculum not only improves objective performance but also leads to more visually reliable enhancement results.
paragraphs.zh: 定性评估。 图 5 展示了在具有不同退化程度的代表性 UIEB 样本上的视觉对比。 现有方法通常存在明显的伪影：UIEC2-Net 往往残留雾感和暗淡的色彩，SCNet 和 FiveA+ 可能引入过度增强或不自然的色偏，WF-Diff 和 CE-VAE 有时无法完全恢复精细结构，而 Phaseformer 虽然更强，但在严重退化下恢复结果仍不够稳定。 相比之下，我们的 TG-Diff 产生了更清晰的可见度、更自然的色彩平衡以及更好的局部细节恢复，如放大区域所示。 在引入 TCDA 之后，“Ours+TCDA” 进一步提升了恢复保真度，尤其是在严重退化的场景中，它能更彻底地去雾并恢复更清晰的纹理和结构。 这些结果验证了所提出的数据中心式课程不仅能提升客观性能，还能带来更视觉可靠的水下增强结果。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose an explicit, controllable degradation modeling framework designed to alleviate the scale and diversity limitations of paired UIE data. We introduce TCDA to synthesize diverse underwater degradations with fine-grained textual control, a progressive degradation curriculum to organize these samples across attributes and difficulty levels, and TG-Diff to incorporate a transmission prior into one-step restoration. Together, these components convert controllable degradation modeling into structured supervision for robust UIE. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate improvements across most restoration and reference-free metrics, while the ablation studies examine the contributions of the curriculum, data augmentation, and transmission guidance. Future work will extend the framework to temporally consistent underwater video enhancement and broader real-world degradation conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种显式、可控的退化建模框架，旨在缓解配对UIE数据在规模和多样性上的限制。 我们引入TCDA来合成具有细粒度文本控制的多样化水下退化，引入渐进式退化课程来按属性和难度级别组织这些样本，并引入TG-Diff将透射率先验融入一步式复原。 这些组件共同将可控退化建模转化为面向鲁棒UIE的结构化监督。 在多个基准上的实验表明，大多数复原指标和无参考指标均有所提升，同时消融研究考察了课程、数据增强和透射率引导的贡献。 未来工作将把该框架扩展到时间一致的水下视频增强以及更广泛的真实世界退化条件。
